metadata.title: That ONE kill that has me asking ‘Did I just glitch the game or what?’
metadata.description:
Wait, how did that hit? My aim took a coffee break but the kill still landed.
Watch me pretend this was all skill and not blind luck.
Only Valorant logic could pull off this disaster.
Click if you’ve ever lucked into a kill and acted like a pro!

Click if your luck sometimes outplays your aim!

#valorant #gaming #funny #clutch #fps
